reuse.why: Extends the existing shared isNonWorkingDay predicate, which every holiday-aware path already calls, and formats with date-fns.

duplication.why: A single added condition in one predicate; no logic is repeated.

placement.why: The holiday-matching rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, where the tree already defines what a non-working day is.

scope.why: One predicate change, two focused tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small, obvious change that every caller picks up automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No call site is touched; all of them already go through isNonWorkingDay.
